title: Valdra Outside
oneLine: Outdoor gear brand with a first-aid line launching in 2026.

hero.alt: The Valdra Outside home page, a three panel banner of trail runners under the brand wordmark

intake.question: What is it, in one sentence?
intake.draft: The website and online presence for VALDRA Outside, an outdoor gear company making first-aid products for adventurers. React 18, React Router, custom CSS, deployed to valdraoutside.com.

intake.question: Role, timeline, status
intake.draft: Solo build. First commit 21 August 2025, last 3 August 2026, 62 commits. Almost exactly a year of ongoing work, which is the most interesting fact about it.

intake.question: What made it hard?
intake.draft: NEEDS YOU: was it the design, the ecommerce side, or working with a client who is also your girlfriend? The last one is a real answer and an interesting one.

intake.question: What did you decide, and what did you reject?
intake.draft: NEEDS YOU: why plain React and custom CSS rather than Shopify or Squarespace for a product company? There is a good answer here and it is probably about control or cost.

intake.question: What number can you put on it?
intake.hint: Traffic or orders if you have them.
intake.draft: 62 commits over 12 months, 5 pages, a hero carousel. NEEDS YOU: traffic, orders, or launch date.

intake.question: What broke, and what did you do?
What media do you have?
intake.draft: Live URL, screenshots, and the adventure photography the site is built around.

intake.question: What would you do differently?
intake.hint: Two sentences. Not self criticism, a design judgement you would make differently now.
